description: A collaborative-learning wiki platform developed by Gerry Stahl and colleagues that provides awareness, navigation, communication, and analysis components for online intersubjective work.
title: Wiki Design Platform

description: Wikiglass is a learning-analytics-enabled awareness tool developed by Hu, Ng, and Chu that provides real-time information about individual and group collaboration to students and teachers.
title: Wikiglass

description: A free online corpus-search tool compiled and designed by Mark Davis that provides searchable English Wikipedia text, concordances, collocations, parts of speech, and synonyms for language learning and research.
title: Wikipedia Corpus

description: A 60-item five-point Likert self-report assessment developed by Williamson to measure self-directed learning across awareness, learning strategies, learning activities, evaluation, and interpersonal skills.
title: Williamson Self-Rating Scale of Self-Directed Learning (SRSSDL)

description: WILSIM-GC is a free web-based interactive landform-evolution simulation developed by Luo et al.
title: WILSIM-GC

description: A standardized written-language assessment published by the World Book Company in which pupils identify and correct embedded errors in compositions, with forms and grade-based norms for grades III–XII.
title: Wilson Language Error Tests (Tests A, B, and C)

description: The Wilson Reading System is a structured literacy curriculum developed by Wilson Language Training for teaching decoding, spelling, fluency, vocabulary, and related reading skills to learners with word-level reading difficulties.
title: Wilson Reading System

description: WindowDash is a synthetic food-delivery teaching-case dataset and accompanying instructional materials developed by Bang An et al.
title: WindowDash

description: A Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction framework defining information and technology literacy content standards, grade-banded performance standards, and proficiency indicators for local curriculum guidance.
title: Wisconsin Information and Technology Literacy Standards

description: WISE Agent (Writing Improvement and Smart Evaluation Agent) is an LLM-based writing-feedback tool developed by Qi Zhu et al.
title: WISE Agent

description: WISE is a web-based science-inquiry authoring and learning platform developed by the University of California, Berkeley, providing teacher tools for creating, managing, and assessing inquiry projects and student tools for structured collaborative investigation.
title: WISE (Web-based Inquiry Science Environment)
